Overview Sinusitis refers to inflammation of the sinus cavities, which are moist, hollow spaces in the bones of the skull. There are four pairs of sinuses: Frontal sinuses Maxillary sinuses Ethmoid sinuses Sphenoid sinuses (not shown in illustration) If the opening from a sinus cavity becomes plugged, the flow of mucus is blocked and pressure builds up, causing pain and inflammation.
